comments:
Block-print produced at Zhol par khang in the early- or mid-nineteenth-century, destroyed in the 1960s during the Cultural Revolution.

One print is preserved at the National Library of Mongolia and was scanned by Asian Classics Input Project (see bdr:MW3CN14268). Another print is preserved at the Bihar Research Society in Patna (No. 1289, B. no. 459) and in the library of Trijang Rinpoche at Ganden Tibetan Monastery (Mundgod, south India), and an incomplete version in St. Petersburg (ACIP id. No. 10424). 
Other prints from these blocks might be the one mentioned in [GP444QCS]: 625, and a copy listed in a catalog from the Kokonor region of Tibet (mTso sngon catalog, p. 625, ACIP R0004).
See [IZK5B2DW], [B8PE93RQ]: xi, and [HCLRANG3]: 10, n. 31.

Another print (non-accessible), presumably from the same block-print in view of the number of folios, is listed in [8H6M69W4]: 1920, No. 22119.
